assays.assay_name: Whole Body Plethysmography (PenH) with Methacholine Challenge
assays.assay_description: Noninvasive bias-flow ventilated whole body plethysmography in spontaneously breathing, unrestrained rats. After 10 min habituation and 5 min baseline, animals were exposed to nebulized saline then increasing methacholine concentrations (4, 8, 16, 32 mg/mL; 3 min nebulization + 3 min recording per dose) with 7 min washout. PenH was used as a proxy for airway resistance/bronchoconstriction. Performed 48 h after final OVA exposure. Tested ~24 different 5-HT2A agonists across phenylalkylamine, ergoline, and tryptamine chemotypes at 0.5 mg/kg inhaled (with additional doses for select compounds).

application_type.evidence: administered either (A) nebulized nose-only or (B) via intraperitoneal injection (i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: baseline data are recorded for 5 min following a 10 min habituation period in the plethysmograph

food_restriction.evidence: Plethysmography chamber; food was not present during the recording session

water_restriction.evidence: Plethysmography chamber; water was not present during the recording session

time_to_assay.evidence: All respiratory parameters were measured 48 h after the final OVA exposure

outcomes.summary: Inhaled (R)-DOI dose-dependently prevented OVA-induced airways hyperresponsiveness (PenH) with EC50 ~0.008 mg/kg (nebulized) and ~0.003 mg/kg (i.p.). SAR screening of 21 5-HT2A agonists showed phenylalkylamines including 2C-H, 2C-B, 2,5-DMA, (R)-DOM, (R)-DOET, (R)-DOiBu, TMA-2, and 4-OH-DIPT were fully efficacious; LSD, ETH-LAD, 2C-B-Fly, TCB-2, 5-iPrO-2C-E, 2C-T-33 were partially efficacious; and lisuride, N,N-DMT, 5-MeO-DMT, 1-methylpsilocin, Ro 60-0175, and BW723C86 showed no efficacy. No correlation was found between efficacy to prevent AHR and calcium mobilization potency/efficacy at 5-HT2A receptors.
outcomes.statistics: PenH AUC vs EMAX calcium: Spearman r = -0.387, p = 0.0754; PenH AUC vs EC50 calcium: Spearman r = 0.2422, p = 0.277; 2-way ANOVA with Bonferroni post hoc
outcomes.evidence: Pretreatment with very low doses of nose-only (R)-DOI (0.01 mg/kg) also completely prevents increases in enhanced pause (PenH).

judge_notes: Only one behavioural-readout assay was scored: whole-body plethysmography with methacholine challenge (PenH). All 21+ compounds were tested in this same paradigm, so per the rubric (same apparatus, same protocol, varying drug) this is one assay.
Dropped histopathology, qRT-PCR, and HEK293 calcium flux assays as they are not behavioural readouts.
B1 scored 0 (single measure: peak PenH). B7 scored 0 because IOX2 computes a derived respiratory index from pressure transduction, which is not a behavioural classifier in the rubric sense.
D2 scored 1 (15-60 min) based on total session duration including habituation, baseline, and four methacholine challenges with washouts (~55 min).
D5 scored 1: behavioral recording occurred 48 h after the final OVA exposure and drug administration.
Schedule classified as 'repeated' because drug was administered prior to each of three OVA challenges across days 14-16.

DOI mapped to '(R)-DOI'; candidate gptoss listed mescaline in psychedelic field but mescaline is mentioned only as a synthesized/provided reagent and was not tested in vivo per Figures 1/7 - retained in reagents list but not as a separately tested dosing entry.
